Homepage11689%https://join.frndlytv.com/
Full-scroll Frndly TV homepage leading with an affordability claim and free 7-day trial CTA, backed by plan pricing starting at $6.99/mo and an extensive channel grid.
Landing-page analysis
Page intent: Get the visitor to start a free 7-day trial of Frndly TV by presenting plans, channel lineup, device compatibility, testimonials, and pricing.
Primary CTA: Start Free Trial
Offer: Free 7-Day Trial
Message match: The page is a full-featured homepage that leads with the same affordability and free-trial message likely in the ad, providing a reasonably consistent destination, though it is a long-scroll homepage rather than a focused conversion page.
Trust: Real Stories from Real Families testimonial section, 50+ channel logos displayed, Compatible with Roku, Samsung, Fire TV, VIZIO, Chromecast, Android TV
Friction: Very long scroll page with many sections before reaching pricing, Multiple CTAs across the page may dilute focus
What works
  • Clear price anchoring with three-tier plan comparison ($6.99, $7.99, $9.99)
  • Free 7-day trial prominently and repeatedly offered
  • Channel grid shows breadth of content upfront
What it misses
  • No sticky or above-fold pricing — visitor must scroll far to see cost
  • No urgency or scarcity signals to compel immediate sign-up
  • Hero section CTA button is small relative to the large headline text

100 of 100 ads · 100% on-brand
HomepageUnknown
SectionAds Share Top destination
Homepage11%https://sling.com/
Sling TV homepage anchored to FIFA World Cup 2026 urgency, presenting five plan tiers from $19.99 and flexible short-term pass options to drive subscription sign-ups.
Landing-page analysis
Page intent: Convert visitors to sign up for a Sling TV subscription plan, anchored by FIFA World Cup 2026 sports content, by presenting plan tiers, channel availability, and flexible pass options.
Primary CTA: Get sling
Offer: 7-Day Pass, 2-Day Pass, and 1-Month Prepay flexible subscription options; free trial mentioned in a banner
Message match: The page has a strong seasonal/event-based focus on FIFA World Cup 2026 rather than a generic homepage feel — it is timely and specific, making it an effective destination for a sports-oriented ad, though it still functions as a full plan-selection homepage.
Trust: 'Watch TV, 100% free' Freestream promotion badge, Compatible devices shown (Roku, LG, VIZIO), Trending channel logos (ESPN, CNN, TNT, TBS, USA, FS1, FOX and others)
Friction: Multiple plan tiers with different price points ($19.99, $19.99, $34.99, $45.99, $45.99) may cause decision paralysis, Dense pricing table with many rows requires careful reading, Very long page with extensive channel and FAQ section in footer area
What works
  • Event-driven hero (FIFA World Cup 2026) creates immediate relevance and urgency
  • Flexible subscription framing (7-Day Pass, 2-Day Pass, 1-Month Prepay) lowers commitment barrier
  • Freestream 'Watch TV, 100% free' cross-promotion adds perceived value
What it misses
  • Five plan tiers shown simultaneously is overwhelming — no clear recommended plan highlighted
  • No customer reviews or social proof visible above the fold
  • Pricing for the hero offer ($19.99) is buried in a subhead rather than prominently featured
